title: AnomalyGFM: Graph Foundation Model for Zero/Few-shot Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2502.09254v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify abnormal nodes that differ from the majority of the nodes in a graph, which has been attracting significant attention in recent years. Existing generalist graph models have achieved remarkable success in different graph tasks but struggle to generalize to the GAD task. This limitation arises from their difficulty in learning generalized knowledge for capturing the inherently infrequent, irregular and heterogeneous abnormality patterns in graphs from different domains. To address this challenge, we propose AnomalyGFM, a GAD-oriented graph foundation model that supports zero-shot inference and few-shot prompt tuning for GAD in diverse graph datasets. One key insight is that graph-agnostic representations for normal and abnormal classes are required to support effective zero/few-shot GAD across different graphs. translated_title: AnomalyGFM：面向零样本/少样本异常检测的图基础模型
translated_abstract: 图异常检测（GAD）旨在识别图中与大多数节点不同的异常节点，近年来受到了广泛关注。现有的通用图模型在不同的图任务中取得了显著成功，但难以泛化到图异常检测任务。这一局限源于它们难以学习到能够捕捉来自不同领域的图中固有的稀少、不规则和异构异常模式的通用知识。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了AnomalyGFM，一个面向图异常检测的图基础模型，支持在多样化图数据集上进行零样本推理和少样本提示调优。一个关键洞察是，需要为正常类和异常类学习图无关的表示，才能在不同图上实现有效的零/少样本图异常检测。受此启发，AnomalyGFM通过预训练来对齐数据无关的、与图无关的正常与异常类表示（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了AnomalyGFM——首个面向图异常检测的图基础模型，通过预训练学习图无关的正常与异常类表示，实现跨不同图数据集的零样本推理和少样本提示调优。
en_tdlr: We propose AnomalyGFM, a graph anomaly detection-oriented graph foundation model that learns graph-agnostic representations for normal and abnormal classes, enabling zero-shot inference and few-shot prompt tuning across diverse graph datasets.
